name: Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco
positioning: Contemporary luxury hotel on Market Street in downtown San Francisco, on 12 floors of a 42-floor building with Equinox Sports Club access
best_for: Travelers who want a Market Street base near Union Square and the Moscone Center
Guests who want access to the Equinox Sports Club and its lap pool

facts.text: The hotel comprises 12 floors of a 42-floor building.
The hotel is at 757 Market Street, San Francisco.
The hotel is in the heart of the Yerba Buena Arts District, steps from Union Square.
MKT Restaurant & Bar is a modern American restaurant in downtown San Francisco.
The MKT menu features California cuisine with locally sourced ingredients such as Mary’s chicken, Liberty Farms duck and Five Dot Ranch prime steaks.
The hotel’s art collection has more than 90 works of art by more than 40 California artists.
Dogs and cats are welcomed with thoughtful amenities.

highlights.text: Hotel guests have unlimited access to the exclusive Equinox Sports Club.
The Equinox Sports Club has a Junior Olympic lap pool.
The Equinox Sports Club has a basketball court.
The Spa at Equinox Sports Club is located on the fourth floor of the hotel.
Guest rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with views of San Francisco.
Guests can relax on a terrace that overlooks the Yerba Buena Gardens.

considerations.text: The valet parking entrance is accessed from Third Street, not Market Street.
Valet parking is available during your stay for a nightly fee.
The Equinox Sports Club welcomes guests aged 15 and older only.
If you’re a luxury traveler looking for a historic San Francisco Hotel, this isn’t it.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise levels.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
